fills.verdictReason: I pulled the video's English auto-transcript (Beastyqt, 'Everything You Need to Know About Scots in Age of Empires IV'). At 83.4s it says: 'so we start with a with a cattle right here.' That supports starting with 1 Highland Cattle. The transcript never gives a starting villager count. It says only that, unlike Vikings, Scots have to produce villagers, and 'six' appears only in '6 berries'. The '6 villagers' part of the claimed value is therefore a guess the source does not support. The only starting condition the video states is the single cattle.

fills.note: SunRunner reads the same text: 'keep ruins can be fully restored to maximum of 600 stone'.
fills.verdictReason: Video wzT5WTqIIU4 is 'Scots in Age of Empires 4: The Full Civilization Guide' by Corvinus1, and I fetched the page myself. The quote falls in the description's 13:12 'Civilization bonuses recap' chapter. My own requests for the captions were IP-blocked ('Sorry' page and youtube_transcript_api IpBlocked). I therefore parsed a raw YouTube json3 caption file for this video ID (wireMagic pb3), which yt-dlp had already saved in the scratchpad. At 868.3s he reads 'Castle ruins'. At 888-899s the captions say: 'keeps become keep ruins and can be saved from total destruction if repaired. Keep ruins can be fully restored for up to maximum 600 stone after which repairing keep ruins becomes free.' So the most stone that restoring a Scots keep ruin can cost is 600. That matches the claimed cap of 600.
